{{Quote|In your considered opinions—who is responsible for this near-atrocity?|Ul-Modo|<ref name="At Your Service">{{LivingForce|At Your Service}}</ref>}}
'''Ul-Modo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]], who worked for the [[Cularin Militia]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ul-Modo attended a conference that was held in the [[Forard]] [[Civic Center (Forard)|Civic Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], to discuss a recent attempt to crash a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] into [[Almas]]. Ul-Modo was chosen to moderate the discussion and during the conference, he asked the [[Heroes of Cularin]] who they believed was behind the launch of the comet.
